titleEn: Shortest and Lexicographically Smallest Beautiful String
title: 最短且字典序最小的美丽子字符串
summary: 在二进制串中寻找恰好含 k 个一的非空子字符串，先要求长度最短，再要求字典序最小；不存在返回空串。
insight: 滑动右端点并维护窗口内一的数量。当一超过 k 时收缩，随后去掉所有前导零；此时若一恰为 k，当前窗口是该右端点下最短候选。比较长度和字典序即可。
pitfalls: 必须恰好包含 k 个一
优先级先最短长度后字典序
候选窗口前导零必须及时删除
一的总数不足 k 时返回空串

solutions.title: 去前导零的滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 维护至多 k 个一，并让合法窗口左端始终落在一上。
steps: right 扫描字符串并更新 ones
当左端是零或 ones>k 时收缩；跨过一要递减 ones
按长度更短或同长字典序更小更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public String shortestBeautifulSubstring(String s,int k){int left=0,ones=0;String answer="";for(int right=0;right<s.length();right++){if(s.charAt(right)=='1')ones++;while(left<=right&&(s.charAt(left)=='0'||ones>k)){if(s.charAt(left++)=='1')ones--;}if(ones==k){String candidate=s.substring(left,right+1);if(answer.isEmpty()||candidate.length()<answer.length()||candidate.length()==answer.length()&&candidate.compareTo(answer)<0)answer=candidate;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun shortestBeautifulSubstring(s:String,k:Int):String{var left=0;var ones=0;var answer="";for(right in s.indices){if(s[right]=='1')ones++;while(left<=right&&(s[left]=='0'||ones>k)){if(s[left++]=='1')ones--};if(ones==k){val candidate=s.substring(left,right+1);if(answer.isEmpty()||candidate.length<answer.length||candidate.length==answer.length&&candidate<answer)answer=candidate}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string shortestBeautifulSubstring(string s,int k){int left=0,ones=0;string answer;for(int right=0;right<(int)s.size();++right){if(s[right]=='1')++ones;while(left<=right&&(s[left]=='0'||ones>k))if(s[left++]=='1')--ones;if(ones==k){string candidate=s.substr(left,right-left+1);if(answer.empty()||candidate.size()<answer.size()||candidate.size()==answer.size()&&candidate<answer)answer=candidate;}}return answer;} };
